implementation.encryption: AES-256-GCM; 32-byte BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY mandatory; plaintext fallback forbidden
implementation.integrity: SHA-256 over ciphertext plus AES-GCM authentication tag, verified before target transaction
implementation.tenantBoundary: organization backup and every restored row are tenant-validated before BEGIN
implementation.restoreBoundary: explicit actor and isolated recovery/test database; source/live target rejected
implementation.audit: create/start/success/failure/denial ledger with UPDATE/DELETE trigger rejection
